en.name: Leukemia
en.shortDescription: Leukemia — malignancy of blood-forming cells; one of the APACHE IV chronic health conditions.
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Leukemia is a malignancy of the blood-forming (haematopoietic) cells, producing abnormal white cells in the blood and bone marrow. In intensive care it is a major comorbidity (cytopenias, immunosuppression, complications of chemotherapy) and a cause of admission. Leukemia is one of the chronic health items in the APACHE IV severity model.

## Scope

The set is anchored on the SNOMED concept *317510 / 93143009 — Leukemia* with all descendants included, capturing acute and chronic leukemias, lymphoid and myeloid lineages, and their subtypes (including leukemia in remission).

## Mapping Notes

- Lymphoma and multiple myeloma are related haematologic malignancies captured by their own sets.
- Leukemia in remission is included in this tree; the set records the diagnosis, not the disease activity status.

versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 165 -> 92 concepts. Added 3 (new or reclassified descendants in the new release): Small lymphocytic B-cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of pelvis (37474337); Small lymphocytic B-cell lymphoma of spleen (37474338); Small lymphocytic B-cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of upper limb (37475327). Removed 71 compound oncology concepts made non-standard by the OHDSI oncology remodelling: the diagnosis now maps to a standard concept already in the set, and the qualifier (stage, subtype, remission/relapse, genetic finding) to Cancer Modifier, Episode or OMOP Genomic. E.g. Chronic myeloid leukemia in remission (132572); Myeloid leukemia in remission (132850); Plasma cell leukemia in remission (133158); and 68 more. Removed 4 concepts made non-standard, mapping to a standard concept already in the set: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis (4003184); Disorder of central nervous system co-occurrent and due to acute lymphoid leukemia (37018869); Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (37119145); Periodontitis co-occurrent with leukemia (46271363). Removed 1 concept made non-standard, mapping outside the set (Malignant lymphoma - small lymphocytic (4119130)): Small lymphocytic B-cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of multiple sites (36684812).
